original_instruction: Wash your hands, then put on clean gloves. Look at the cut on the skin pad. Check that it is not red, swollen or leaking. Place a non-stick pad over the whole cut on the skin pad. Put the pad wrapper into the zip bag and seal it. Then take off the gloves and wash your hands.
excluded_completion_note: Call your nurse if the wound becomes more red, swollen or warm, starts leaking, or if you get a fever.
